newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Guangnan says to issue 144 mln warrants.
newsitem.headline: Guangnan says to issue 144 mln warrants.

text.p: Food distributor Guangnan (Holdings) Ltd said it planned to issue 144.03 million warrants at HK$0.35 per warrant, raising net proceeds of HK$49.1 million for corporate funding and working capital.

Guangnan said in a statement about 71.4 percent of the warrant issue would be offered to its shareholders on the basis of one warrant for every seven shares held. The remaining 28.6 percent of the issue would be placed with independent institutional and professional investors, it said.
Each warrant entitles the holder the right to subscribe for one Guangnan share at an initial subscription price of HK$7.50 per share before the warrants expire on August 31, 1998.
Guangnan shares ended at HK$7.20 on Thursday.
If all the warrants are exercised, Guangnan said it would be required to issue about 144.03 million new shares, representing about 16.7 percent of its enlarged share capital.
Guangnan said proceeds of about HK$1.08 billion to be raised from the future exercise of warrants would be used for financing potential investment and business development projects.
